about.backgroundP1: The AI tool that has shaken the world and is driving it toward a real revolution is the LLM – a large language model that makes it possible to simulate a conversation with a real human being.
about.backgroundP2Line1: Following this invention, many chat tools were developed that let any internet user open a conversation and talk as they please.
about.backgroundP2Line2: Not only over the internet. Today there are programs that can be installedon any standard computer.
about.backgroundP2Line3: (Minimum requirements as of now - 8GB RAM, i5 processor) A local chat thatcan be talked to even without any connection to the internet or any other external source.
about.backgroundP3Line1: All of humanity has entered a large-scale social experiment, the results of which we will see over the coming years.
about.backgroundP3Line2: The implications of the ability to communicate with a human-like figure, whose views can be shaped by its creators, and whose behavior, conversation flow and tone are deliberately designed, can vary widely:
about.backgroundP3Line3: From professional conversation that produces amazing results,
about.backgroundP3Line5: to personal, emotional conversations about private matters that can end upharming the user.
about.backgroundP4: (And for all these implications there are already cases today with names and details that can be told.)
about.valuesP1Line1: As Jews, servants of Hashem, who observe Torah and mitzvot,
about.valuesP1Line2: every revolution is a time of test.
about.valuesP1Line3: We cannot accept the future with indifference and without preparing for it.
about.valuesP1Line4: Today – about two years after this tool burst onto the public in full force, and it is here to stay – we have reached a point where we must manage a strategy.
about.valuesP2: Those who tremble at the word of Hashem need to rise up and declare things that, until yesterday, were clear and self-evident:
about.valuesList2: Don't let strangers into the house
about.valuesP3Line1: No mother would send her daughter to the yard if she knew a strange, bored woman was standing there, wanting to chat with her endlessly, advise her, guide her and give her feedback, with the main goal of keeping the conversation going until night... and continuing again tomorrow...
about.valuesP3Line2: No father would leave alone at home an air-conditioning technician who came towork, but who starts talking to the yeshiva student, taking a warm interest in him, complimenting him, asking questions, and making all sorts of offers...
about.marketHeading: The current state of the market:
about.marketPLine1: The use of AI tools is unavoidable. Developers, graphic designers and maintainers already need these tools today.
about.marketPLine2: And in the job market, the more advanced a tool becomes, and the wider the range of available tools, the faster and better the results.
about.marketPLine3: In many homes, everyday use of AI has also become common outside of work.
about.problemPLine1: In order to return to a proper Jewish standpoint, a response must be given. Itseems impossible to simply decree "AI tools may not be used"
about.problemPLine3: banning all technology-related professions / great difficulty in complying with such a directive - for large parts of the community
about.goalPLine1: Using AI for professional purposes only, to solve concrete tasks.
about.goalPLine2: Not using it as a "person" that one can chat with and get information from on any subject.
about.directionHeading: A proposed direction for a solution:
about.directionPLine1: AI is a person – like with any person – if it is not familiar, or is familiar but holds views foreign to Judaism –
about.directionPLine2: we don't want a relationship with it. When necessary – then formal and minimal.
about.directionPLine3: AI is a tool – like any new tool that is created – one needs to learn how touse it safely and enjoy its capabilities.
about.directionPLine4: Perhaps it's worth remembering that there is also the option of taking computers out of the home.
about.directionPLine5: Strangers outside have always existed and always will...
about.filteringList1: Core filtering – filtering out content that is completely forbidden.
about.filteringList2: Domain filtering – the ability to define a domain for which the system is built, so as to prevent irrelevant conversation.
about.goalProductsPLine1: Once there is a filtering infrastructure, it becomes relatively quick andeasy to build systems that perform tasks for any domain.
about.goalProductsPLine2: Starting with neutral products that answer professionally and impartiallyon any topic,
about.goalProductsPLine3: this is a basic lifeline – the ability to forbid the use of any open chatsuch as (ChatGPT, Gemini, etc.)
about.goalProductsPLine4: True, the user experience will be reduced (no feedback, no further suggestions),
about.goalProductsPLine5: but with an explanation this will be accepted by God-fearing people.
about.goalProductsPLine6: and ending with dedicated products for -
about.goalProductsPLine7: programming / secretarial work / bookkeeping / graphic design and any other relevant field.
about.asidePLine1: Side note: today the strongest tools being built are purpose-driven.
about.asidePLine2: This way of working is also being adopted in product development around the world, out of an understanding that uncontrolled use of AI is very problematic in terms of security and performance.
about.providerSubheading: Managing communication with AI only through a protected provider:
about.providerP: Once filtering systems for AI are developed, it will be possible to close off communication with external providers - today this is the only way to guarantee full protection.
about.whyNotHeading: Why the solution doesn't exist yet:
about.whyNotPLine1: We simply haven't organized ourselves properly yet. That seems to be the only reason.
about.whyNotPLine2: During the attempt to develop an extension similar to existing ones, and later also an API and additional products,
about.whyNotPLine3: it became very clear that with the tools that exist today for development,
about.whyNotPLine4: the task of producing alternatives is entirely feasible in terms of time and resources.
about.whyNotPLine5: What's needed right now is a small development team (1-3 people) for product development and technical support.
about.whyNotPLine6: Or perhaps also an organized community management effort that gathers inquirieson the subject, updates, and requests.
about.whyNotPLine7: We have reached a point in time where we need to stop and reorganize everything.
about.whyNotList1: We are in control of the issue.
about.whyNotList3: The dangers can easily be defined.
about.whyNotList4: Solutions can be presented with reasonable effort.
about.ctaHeading: We've set up a community on GitHub ===>
about.ctaP: Do you have something to contribute? Come in here:
about.knowledgePLine1: Do you have something to add?

aboutCompany.heading: This isn't just another system.  It's a systemic solution.
aboutCompany.communityP: SafeAI 613 is an emerging open-source community focused on developing tools and technologies for filtering and safely using artificial intelligence. We believe in transparency, collaboration, and an open approach to technology that allows everyone to use AI responsibly and safely.
aboutCompany.visionP: To create an infrastructure of open-source tools that allow any organization, educational institution, or developer to integrate artificial intelligence safely, in a filtered way that is tailored to their values. We are building the tools that will enable accessible use of AI while maintaining safety, privacy, and ethics.
aboutCompany.projectsPLine1: Our community develops a variety of open-source projects - from filtering proxies and servers, through SDKs for various programming languages, to extensions for development environments.
aboutCompany.projectsPLine2: All projects are available on GitHub, and in the future will be documented and built out to allow any developer to join and contribute.
aboutCompany.joinFeature1: Open and transparent code - all projects available on GitHub
aboutCompany.joinFeature2: Modular tools that can be easily integrated
aboutCompany.joinFeature3: An active and supportive community of developers
aboutCompany.githubSectionP: All our projects are available in our organization on GitHub:

products.heading: Our Projects
products.intro: Open-source projects for filtering and safe use of artificial intelligence - all toolsavailable on GitHub
products.integrationVideoTitle: Integration with External Apps and Tools
products.proxyP: An advanced proxy and filtering server that enables real-time filtering of requests and responses from language model APIs. Includes a management interface, custom filtering profiles, and a monitoring system.
products.proxyFeature2: Support for all leading AI providers
products.libreChatP: A chat solution based on LibreChat with built-in filtering, suitable for educational institutions and organizations. Convenient interface, full Hebrew support, and connection to our filtering server.
products.libreChatFeature2: Full support for Hebrew and English
products.sdkP: A Python package for implementing AI content filtering directly in applications. Includes filtering functions, integration with embedding models, and tools for building safe prompts.
products.sdkFeature4: Support for text and prompt filtering
products.continueP: A VS Code extension based on Continue with built-in filtering. Enables the use of an AI coding assistant safely and with filtering directly in the development environment.
products.continueFeature2: Automatic filtering of code and prompts
products.continueFeature3: Support for local and remote models
